reviewer_request: Train a model using only the in-house adaptation subjects to quantify what external labelled data add.
train_setting: in-house main150 only for both population and source roles
target_access: full unlabeled held-out test batch is used by domain_z normalization and source-similarity gate, matching the existing adaptation convention
source_gate: one local source (main150); source weight is therefore exactly 1.0 and no cross-source routing is estimated

bootstrap.estimand: equal-weight mean of five fixed-split patient metrics

interpretation: External-label contribution is exploratory; intervals crossing zero are not evidence of no effect or equivalence.
